generations.prompt: Naturalistic footage inside a long, almost empty room in an old house: pale lime-washed walls with nothing on them, a dark wide-plank wooden floor, a tall sash window with white muslin at the far end, soft grey morning daylight lying in a long pale rectangle across the floor; a plain dark wooden chair near the camera at the bottom left with its back to the camera, a small plain wooden table with a white cup and a low stool near the window. Audio: her footsteps on the wooden boards, the soft rustle of her dress, the hush of an empty room, faint birds outside the window. No music, no speech, no humming, no voice.
